name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Place a flat bench facing away from a low pulley with a straight bar attached.
Lie face up with your head near the pulley, feet planted, and hold the bar overhand above your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar under control just past your forehead.
Extend both elbows to press the bar back above your shoulders.
tips: Keep your upper arms angled slightly toward the pulley throughout the movement.
Keep your elbows pointed forward instead of letting them flare outward.
